scores.tell: Map stack floats on flat striped backdrop with no ground plane; viewpoint consistent and mild, close to real floating-object cards.
Clock is flat-on frontal with a faux wall/floor strip; very orthographic, one shallow layer. Slightly flatter than reals, but fine.
Truss and spotlight use stronger perspective convergence, truss receding diagonally; the pivot and bracket view is slightly inconsistent. Background is a plain gradient.
Wide-angle depth: the train's front is strongly foreshortened with a steep rail ground plane and layered desert and sky. Heavier than the reals' mild perspective.
Fins tilted with consistent mild top view, floating on a radial backdrop; matches the real towel-style floaters.
Bottle tilted, floating, on a rays backdrop; one consistent mild view and no ground. Close to the reals.
Cauldron on a tiled floor with a steep ground plane against a flat striped wall; the tiles' perspective is stronger than the wall's. Reads like the cat and barrel lesson cards.
Rover on lunar ground with a radial-ray sky; high three-quarter view with fairly strong convergence on the wheels and box. Ground is a bit steep.

Many depth layers: topiary, hedge, lawn, path and sky, with a curved path showing a wide ground plane and a deep background. The topiary also sits at an eye-level view, so it looks like a scene rather than a card.

Wide ocean horizon with a pier receding in strong perspective, plus sand, water and sky layers. The horizon is flat and the planks converge strongly, which is a scene-like view unlike the reals' mild perspective.
